name: Table 80: Grinding Complications
description: Rulebook Table 80 (p.373). The Necropolis Neighborhood (Third Floor, The Over City) grinding complications, tied to the Hobgoblin Mortuary Assistants and the feuding funeral families.

results.name: The Dispenser crop-dusts the battlefield
results.description: Just as the crawlers leap out to attack a group of Shambling Berserkers, the Dispenser flies over, crop-dusting the battlefield with its red mist, making the fight much more difficult and giving them a taste of the upcoming Boss Battle.

results.name: A disrespectful funeral duo
results.description: The crawlers encounter a Goblin and Hobgoblin duo supposedly performing a funeral for a group of grieving Elves, but they lack any of the decorum or respect commonly exhibited by the Hobgoblin Mortuary Assistants. The Goblin even passes a tip jar to the Elves, refusing to continue until a few coins are dropped in.

results.name: Crashed hearses and Rumble Weeds
results.description: Hearses from two of the three families have crashed into each other, leading to a loud argument between the drivers, mismatched corpses, and the attention of some nearby Rumble Weeds.

results.name: Ruin Flocker nest holds a captive
results.description: The crawlers find a nest of Ruin Flocker eggs guarded by a territorial Level 16 Ruin Flocker mother hen. She has captured someone they know and trapped them in the nest as a makeshift egg-warmer while she patrols the perimeter.

results.name: Clan Boltcrank's experimental gas backfires
results.description: A scientist from Clan Boltcrank attempts to purge a mausoleum with an experimental gas that accidentally fuses all the Shambling Berserkers inside to create a monstrous Level 25 Berserker Pile. This becomes an upgraded Shambling Berserker with Constitution 40 (+5). Now the crawlers must fight the Mob, cover the scientist as they prepare another device to undo the fusion, seal the mausoleum, or flee for their lives.

results.name: Asked to serve as pallbearers
results.description: The crawlers are approached by a Hobgoblin Mortuary Assistant who asks them to serve as pallbearers for the funeral of someone who has no one to mourn them. This can be an antagonistic NPC, a crawler they used to know, or anyone else who might stir up some drama.
